question: The weight loss and marked depletion of subcutaneous fat and muscle mass are characteristic features of which syndrome occurs in infants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Marasmus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marasmus** is a **nutrition deficiency disorder**.
 
• Marasmus is mainly caused by a severe deficiency of **protein, vitamins, minerals, carbohydrates, and parasitic infections**.
 
• These diseases mainly occur in **babies, young children, and adults**.
 
• The symptoms include **weight loss, dizziness, and dehydration.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Down Syndrome**:

 
 
• **Down syndrome** was earlier classified as** mongolism**. Another name for Down syndrome is **trisomy 21**. 
 
• Down syndrome is characterized by **delayed and abnormal physical growth** and **intellectual disabilities**.
 
• People with Down syndrome are prone to other health problems such as **leukemia, epilepsy, congenital heart defects**, etc. 
 
 
 
• **Eczema**:
 
 
• Several different types of **skin swelling** are referred to as **eczema**.

 **Dermatitis** is another name for **eczema**.
 
• It results in **dry, itchy skin and rashes** on the **hands, feet, elbows, and knees** as well as on the** face**.
 
• It is brought on by a confluence of **stress, genetics, environmental stimuli, and immune system activation**.
 
 
 
• **Pertussis**:
 
 
• **Whooping cough** is also known as **Pertussis**.
 
• Pertussis is a **bacterial infection** of the **respiratory tract** caused by **Bordetella Pertussis**.
 
• It is a highly contagious disease that causes **inflammation** in the **upper respiratory tract**.
